phase_prompt.label: Endurance of the Variable Winds
phase_prompt.summary: The inhabitants stand exposed on the surface plane, subjected to the shifting vectors of the twelve wind gates. They are weather-beaten and stoic, grounded in a reality that oscillates between abundance and devastation.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A photorealistic, cinematic shot of a group of inhabitants on the surface_plane, bracing against a strong, invisible wind. Their clothing flaps violently, revealing heavy textures of wool and rough linen mixed with subtle synthetic sheens. Dust and small particles of data-glass swirl around them, caught in the vector fields of the air. Their expressions are stoic, eyes squinting against the harsh light of the upper_store. The skin is rendered with extreme detail, showing the dryness of the wind and the glisten of sweat. The background is a blur of heat haze and distant, dark clouds gathering at the edge of the simulation box. The lighting is low-angle and golden, highlighting the edges of their silhouettes against the darkening sky.
